comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
A quality fix for an annoying BSG bug!

For anyone thinking about playing live again (where this mod can’t help you) given that the pre-wipe events have started, and wipe is allegedly next week: there’s actually a method to repeatably get into and out of the bugged state that this mod fixes:

* Hold vault hotkey
* Open inventory screen (i.e. hit “tab”, or loot a body/container)
* Release vault hotkey
* Close inventory screen

This works in both directions–both to enter the bugged state this mod fixes, and to exit that bugged state.
